plan.objective: Obtain the referenced Zork gameplay video, extract every player move in order from the video evidence, and write /app/solution.txt with one move per line.
plan.current_focus: Discover a feasible local-access path to the video and any available transcription/extraction tooling in the constrained environment.
plan.implementation_approach: 1) Inspect workspace and receipts for any prior download/transcription work. 2) Use available shell tools to probe whether the video can be accessed or whether an equivalent local copy already exists. 3) If accessible, extract the move sequence from the video evidence and create /app/solution.txt. 4) Verify the file contents against the extracted evidence.
plan.validation_strategy: Require receipt-backed evidence for: source video used, extracted move sequence, and /app/solution.txt contents matching the sequence in order.
plan.verification_test_strategy: Use receipts/view_receipt rather than rerunning equivalent commands; only finalize when evidence refs show the video-derived moves and the written file contents.
known_bad_behavior: Treating file existence or non-empty output as sufficient.
evidence_gaps: No receipt-backed evidence yet for the video source.
risks: No download tools are currently visible.
Video transcription may require alternative accessible sources or manual extraction from visible evidence.
next_steps: Inspect prior receipts for any existing download or extraction evidence.
Probe the workspace for any local copy or accessible source of the video.
Proceed with extraction only if a real video source is obtained.
finalization_requirements: Receipt-backed evidence of the video source used for transcription.
Receipt-backed evidence showing the extracted move sequence.
Receipt-backed evidence that /app/solution.txt contains the extracted moves in order.
